title: MeterRouter: Budget-Aware Dynamic Routing for Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.34327v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) outperform single-agent systems, but inter-agent communication incurs substantial token overhead. While assigning a large LLM to every agent is common, it results in inefficient resource utilization, leaving the system far from the Pareto frontier. The cost of answering a query is set jointly by how many agents are recruited, the role and LLM assigned to each, and communication topology among them. Most existing routers treat cost only implicitly rather than as an explicit optimization constraint. A fixed accuracy-cost preference also cannot express how much a caller is willing to pay for a particular query. We introduce MeterRouter, a budget-aware dynamic router that incrementally synthesizes a collaboration graph by selecting each agent's role, LLM, incoming connections, and termination conditioned on the query and a per-query monetary budget. translated_title: MeterRouter：面向多智能体系统的预算感知动态路由
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的多智能体系统（MAS）优于单智能体系统，但智能体间的通信会产生大量token开销。虽然为每个智能体分配大模型的做法很常见，但这会导致资源利用效率低下，使系统远离帕累托前沿。回答一个查询的成本由多个因素共同决定：招募多少个智能体、分配给每个智能体的角色和大语言模型，以及它们之间的通信拓扑结构。大多数现有路由器只是隐式地考虑成本，而非将其作为显式的优化约束。固定的准确率-成本偏好也无法表达调用者针对特定查询愿意支付多少费用。我们提出了MeterRouter，一个预算感知的动态路由器，它根据查询内容和每次查询的货币预算，通过为每个智能体选择角色、大语言模型、入边连接和终止条件，逐步构建协作图。我们通过……初始化路由器（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了MeterRouter，一个预算感知的动态路由器，能根据查询内容和每次查询的货币预算，动态决定各智能体的角色、大语言模型、连接关系和终止条件来构建协作图，将成本作为显式优化约束纳入多智能体系统。
en_tdlr: MeterRouter is a budget-aware dynamic router that incrementally synthesizes a multi-agent collaboration graph by selecting each agent's role, LLM, incoming connections, and termination conditioned on the query and a per-query monetary budget, treating cost as an explicit optimization constraint.
